title: Coefficient equivalences conjugate bounded-below direct image
statement: For a finite discrete commutative ring B, the explicitly constructed coefficient equivalences E_S and E_T, and a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism h:S to T, applying the internal derived direct image to E_S of a bounded-below pro-etale module complex is naturally isomorphic to applying E_T to the bounded-below module-valued pro-etale direct image.

proof.text: Unfold the common coefficient equivalence into the sectionwise additive encoding and the constant-ring equivalence. The equality hG identifies all sectionwise restriction maps, while naturality of the coefficient-ring map pulled back from the profinite point identifies scalar actions after direct image.

The resulting underived natural isomorphism is transported through the exact coefficient equivalences and the right-derived-functor construction. Restricting to bounded-below objects and including them into the full derived category gives the displayed objectwise isomorphism.

proof_origin.note: Strict lower-level coefficient-conjugation interface needed to transport the ordinary finite-coefficient direct-image comparison.

theorem finiteDiscreteCoefficient_directImage_conjugation [DiscreteTopology B] [Finite B]
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} (h : S ⟶ T) [QuasiCompact h] [QuasiSeparated h] :
    ∀ X : DerivedCategory.Plus (FiniteDiscreteProEtaleSheaves B S),
      Nonempty (
        (D((finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG T).functor)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj
              ((R+(ProEtale.lowerStar
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} B)) h)).obj X)) ≅
        (coefficientDerivedLowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj B) h).obj
          ((D((finiteDiscreteCoefficientEquivalence B eR G hG S).functor)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι.obj X)))
